findings.title: Separate independent request checks and lifecycle steps
findings.cause: Several short guard/validation blocks run directly into the next independent preparation or polling operation. This violates the attached explicit paragraph rule even when rustfmt accepts the file.
findings.remedy: Whitespace only: separate body-plan/priority guards from preparation; request preparation from forward URI conversion/optional overrides; required extended connection guard from send; eligibility guards from clone/probe; no-limit guard from nanosecond conversion; taken-handle guard from supervisor setup; timer schedule guard from poll loop. Keep related assignments and conversion chains together.
findings.observable_contract: No behavior change intended. All request validation, stream cancellation, response lease and shutdown outcome behavior must remain byte-for-byte code-equivalent except whitespace.
findings.verification: Source-confirmed standards gap only; targeted format and diff review suffice for whitespace once assigned; no new behavior tests justified.
findings.status: reported to integration owner; no edits authorized or performed in this read-only pass

assessment: Preparation validates settings and structured request/trailer/priority plans before connection/body use. Origin forwarding uses structured URI parts; extended CONNECT waits actual peer capability and never silently falls back.

RequestStreamGuard owns SendStream through lexical upload. Response-head/upload selection retains ongoing upload in Http2Body, or records completed inbound state before cancelling an abandoned upload. Body and accepted tunnel leases keep ConnectionInner alive.

The facade acquires shared origin admission before setup; setup reservations clear/notify on Drop and waiters register before locking. Response extensions retain OpenStream and Permit; pool retry is explicit and bounded. Supporting pool paths are partial, not whole pool approval.

is_reusable is deliberately a snapshot, not a reservation. Backend SendRequest clone has no pending stream; poll_ready checks connection state while actual spread/admission/send govern capacity. The spread source and its actual assumed-limit/capacity literals were read in full as supporting evidence.

Final ConnectionInner Drop closes sender before initiating DriverTask shutdown. AbortDriver and DriverOutcome exist before spawn; supervisor completion observes protocol and join categories, timeout requests abort, runtime future Drop also aborts and records runtime_shutdown.

The process timer is concrete runtime-owned lifetime service. wait_for_driver polls the task before the deadline, so completed driver result wins simultaneous expiry. Supervisor Drop/timeout requests cancellation; it does not promise synchronous joined driver completion.

Owner Debug/spans emit closed state, method/protocol/size/status/outcomes and reason/IO/panic flags, not authority, credentials, headers or payload. RequestHeader sensitive Debug is explicitly redacted in the supporting request source.

No unsafe block, recoverable-input panic, unchecked external slice index, poisoned user-state mutex or unbounded spawned request-body task was found in either owner. Guard access and backend errors are typed; source size alone does not justify another module or generic helper.

qualified_rejected_candidates.candidate: Detached request upload loses stream cancellation
qualified_rejected_candidates.evidence: PendingUpload is a lexical future owning RequestStreamGuard; its Drop sends CANCEL. Active upload is transferred into response body rather than spawned. Backend reference Drop also cancels streams with no remaining interest.

qualified_rejected_candidates.candidate: Dropping facade connection invalidates active response/tunnel
qualified_rejected_candidates.evidence: ConnectionLease Arc keeps ConnectionInner/driver alive until body or accepted tunnel drops. Classic held rejection is private and its retry caller retains the connection during the challenge exchange.

qualified_rejected_candidates.candidate: Every rejected CONNECT end-of-stream error must replace final rejection
qualified_rejected_candidates.evidence: An actual final response status is already received. Empty DATA has zero payload and backend state guards yield inactive/incorrect state after reset/close. Extended CONNECT propagates IO/GOAWAY; classic response status takes precedence by explicit comment. Caller checks eligibility before reusing. Not a new silent protocol change claim.

qualified_rejected_candidates.candidate: is_reusable reserves or proves peer capacity
qualified_rejected_candidates.evidence: Public docs say snapshot and no reservation. Actual backend clone readiness and facade stream-count/admission paths establish separate contracts; later send can still fail.

qualified_rejected_candidates.candidate: Supervisor detached JoinHandle proves permanent driver leak
qualified_rejected_candidates.evidence: Supervisor owns AbortDriver guard before spawn; timer and runtime cancellation request abort. Drop cannot await; no synchronous closure guarantee claimed. Existing shutdown controls retain explicit runtime boundary and final outcome observations.

qualified_rejected_candidates.candidate: Discarded runtime-neutral timer error is a new caller cause loss
qualified_rejected_candidates.evidence: Timer failure causes task_error outcome and driver abort after connection owner Drop; there is no public async shutdown Result to return the timer value through. Existing fixture deadline typed error repairs remain separate and covered.

qualified_rejected_candidates.candidate: ReadIdle nanoseconds overflow panics or moves idle time backward
qualified_rejected_candidates.evidence: u64 conversion saturates, atomic fetch_max is monotonic; elapsed time uses monotonic Instant. The u64 nanosecond horizon is centuries, not an observed runtime issue.

qualified_rejected_candidates.candidate: Existing H2 streaming and shutdown findings remain unfixed
qualified_rejected_candidates.evidence: Current supporting repaired helper paths retain typed completion/cleanup causes and bounded joins. Historical source identities remain historical where changed; current bytes are compared explicitly and supporting partial ranges remain partial.

supporting_fixture_limits.qualification: The literal stalled upload, actual CANCEL and later204 reuse are strong independent protocol oracles. Raw peer/request tasks can lose their successful-path join on early errors. Runtime ultimately owns these tasks; this is supporting source qualification, not a measured surviving-socket/production leak. Older continuation/body reports already described runtime-owned fixture limits; do not silently reopen current repaired driver_shutdown/streaming controls.

Selected raw peers have successful-path awaits and meaningful exact partial DATA/CANCEL/closed/tracing observations. Early client/assertion exits bypass an explicit join. Only1-145 read here; no whole final fixture approval or native leak claim.

supporting_source_findings.title: Observe stalled-upload fixture tasks and retain deadline/channel causes
supporting_source_findings.cause: Raw peer22/upload31 handles are joined only along the accepted path. A peer failure before accepted publication closes the channel;46-48 substitutes text for RecvError and exits before observing either task. Absolute parent timeout/panic drops raw handles, which detach under pinned Tokio1.53.1. Upload32/44 stringifies original input/H2 causes; peer105-106 stringifies actual Elapsed.
supporting_source_findings.supported_disposition: Source-confirmed fixture ownership and typed cause gaps; older reports qualified runtime-owned peer cleanup. Not a production defect or executed leak result.
affected_branches: Peer protocol/I/O failure before accepted publication closes channel and skips both joins.
Outer absolute deadline/panic before normal peer join detaches handles; upload owns a connection clone.
Unexpected upload preparation/send failure is stringified before task result observation.
Missing reset before peer timeout discards actual Elapsed.
independent_control_proposals: Complete root204 and drive zero-window POST; inject a concrete typed peer fault before accepted publication, retain client/runtime and require joined peer cause plus primary channel cause. Fault reachability and terminal result need baseline execution.
Cancel outer owner only after actual POST acceptance; retain live runtime/client outside, observe bounded task/destructor completion and cleanup before assertion. No permanent leak assertion.
Hold reset observation pending after actual accepted POST; expire typed deadline and require source downcast to actual Elapsed, preserving positive exact CANCEL/subsequent204.
supporting_source_findings.remedy_scope: Separate bounded fixture assignment after baseline; concrete lexical joins or owner compatible with actual task result; preserve primary plus cleanup failures.
supporting_source_findings.verification: Source and resolved Tokio Drop contract only; no new controls authored or executed.
